answer: Re-attestations are stored in sonnet and jade lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the anchor graph. Standing lapses unless 2 peers re-attest it every 12 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Verification costs 8 dollars and 3 days per identity, which turns a 3595 account sybil into a 7 million dollar project with no guaranteed return. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
